title: key trait design: DecryptionKey/SigningKey abstraction is well-crafted
description: The DecryptionKey and SigningKey traits correctly separate the 'what to do with a key' question from 'where the key lives'. The default impl of agree_ecdh() that returns Err(UnsupportedAlgorithm) means RSA-only callers don't need to implement ECDH. The default impl of preferred_digest_algorithm() returning None means simple callers don't override cert-derived selection. The supported_key_enc_algorithm() extension point is correctly documented as informational only. A contributor might suggest removing these defaults for 'cleaner trait design' — they should not; the defaults reduce boilerplate for the majority of callers who only do RSA.
